Major Rock Island Line Construction Begins the Evening of Friday, August 21

Major Rock Island construction begins the evening of Friday, August 21. Evening train cancellations are posted on Metra.com. There will be no train service on August 22 and 23. Visit Metra.com or MetraTracker.com to plan alternate travel.

RID - 115th St./Morgan Park Station Construction

The north/south parking lots at the 115th St/Morgan Park station are now open to the public and ADA accessibility has been restored. Station construction is expected to continue through Spring 2027. Metra will provide updates once construction is complete.

All trains will ground load at 111th, 107th, 103rd, 91st, 87th, 83rd, 79th, and 75th Street.

All trains will ground load at 111th, 107th, 103rd, 91st, 87th, 83rd, 79th, and 75th Street. Do not operate chains or gates and follow the train crew's instructions after the train stops. Stations will not be ADA-accessible.

Public transit is the best choice for music fans headed to Lollapalooza

Starting Thursday, July 30 through Sunday, Aug. 2, Metra will provide extra trains on 7 of its 11 lines to accommodate the anticipated demand for Lollapalooza ridership. Detailed Metra schedules for Lollapalooza weekend can be found at metra.com/schedules.

ME Beginning May 18 South Water Elevator Will Be Closed

Starting May 18, the South Water elevator will be closed during reconstruction. ADA passengers should use Van Buren St or Museum Campus/11th St for elevator access. For the latest service alert info visit Metra.com/MEelevators.

Alcohol and Bike Restrictions - August 1-2, 2026 (UPDATE)

Due to anticipated Lollapalooza crowds this weekend, passengers are encouraged to park their bikes at the stations. Alcohol will be restricted on all Metra trains and bikes will be restricted on some trains Saturday and Sunday, August 1-2, 2026.

Milwaukee District North Major Track Project Affecting Midday Service Aug 3 - Oct 23

August 3 - October 23, track work to replace 4.5 miles of rail will affect midday service between Fox Lake and Lake Forest. Passengers boarding at these stations should utilize alternate Metra lines or other transportation. Visit metra.com for more info.
